title: The Shadow of the Lace Curtain
youtube_title: The Shadow of the Lace Curtain | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A small beautiful thing can be shared with the eyes only.
summary: At a harbor wall at low tide, Cosima finds a lace curtain printing flowers on the floor. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Cosima shows Elif how to look without disturbing it. the ferryman looks too, and they leave it where it is.
